validity.recommendation: Check the cost of 53.12 billion rubles and the start year of 2023, which no citation supports; check the 31.5 billion figure in the planning decree against 63
validity.researcher_notes: Capacity, diameter and status match the sheet. The length of 1625 agrees with the 1625.6 km that Interfax gives. The cost and the start year are not supported by any harvested citation. Work was still tendered in May 2025, so a start year of 2023 looks out of date. The planning decree in its October 2026 version gives up to 31.5 billion cubic meters a year in item 19, which may refer to part of the route.

fills.researcher_notes: The contractor ZAO GSP page, read through the September 2020 archived copy, says the Pochinki to Anapa section is part of the second stage of the Eastern corridor to supply gas of up to 63.0 billion cubic meters a year. Gazprom Proektirovanie, the operator's design institute, says in March 2021 that the pipeline capacity will be up to 63 billion cubic meters a year. The sheet value of 63 is the same. The two are from different organizations, one a contractor and one the design institute of the operator.

Rossiyskaya Gazeta reported on 22 July 2022 that the new Pochinki to Anapa pipeline has a diameter of 1420 mm and was connected in May 2022 to the six-line Urengoy to Pomary to Uzhgorod corridor. The sheet value of 1420 is the same.

Interfax reported on 19 July 2019 that the length of the Pochinki to Anapa pipeline is 1625.6 km. Neftegaz repeats 1625.6 km in 2019 and 2021, but it appears to take the figure from the same Gazprom statement. Rossiyskaya Gazeta in July 2022 gives 1622 km from Pochinki compressor station to the Russkaya compressor station site. The sheet holds 1625, which agrees with the 1625.6 within rounding. No second independent source agrees on one precise figure, so the sheet value stays.

No harvested citation states the sheet cost of 53.12 billion rubles for this pipeline. The Moscow Times in July 2019, citing Vedomosti, gives 715 billion rubles at 2012 prices for the whole Southern Corridor, which covers both the Pisarevka to Anapa and the Pochinki to Anapa lines, so it is not a figure for this row. Neftegaz gives 16.6 billion rubles in 2014 for two sections of 295.7 km. The sheet value and its existing reference stay for a person to check.

No harvested citation gives a start year of 2023 for the whole pipeline. A regional report of July 2022 says another 145.5 km was planned to be finished by the end of 2023. A Gazprom Transgaz Saratov newspaper of April 2023 and a May 2025 tender list show construction still going on, so a start in 2023 looks out of date. The sheet value stays for a person to check.

A Gazprom Transgaz Saratov newspaper of 7 April 2023 reports work on a trenchless crossing of the Pochinki to Anapa pipeline under the Saratov to Petrovsk road. A Saratov region ministry report of July 2022 says 51 km are built in the region and another 145.5 km were planned by the end of 2023. A Gazprom tender list of May 2025 still offers construction work on the Pochinki to Anapa sections between km 661 and km 834. The sheet status of construction is the same.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: A Gazprom tender list of May 2025 still offers construction work on the Pochinki to Anapa pipeline, and a Gazprom Transgaz Saratov newspaper reports works in April 2023. No citation reports the whole pipeline commissioned.

cross_row_leads.note: The planning decree 816-r in its 9 October 2026 version gives up to 31.5 billion cubic meters a year in item 19, the Eastern corridor. A later search could check whether the capacity of this pipeline has been reduced from 63.

Neftegaz, 26 March 2021, read through the January 2023 archived copy. Repeats the state review of km 963.7 to km 1168.1 and a capacity of up to 63 billion cubic meters a year, and gives 1625.6 km for the whole line.

Federal planning decree 816-r in the version of 9 October 2026. Item 19, the Eastern corridor expansion, lists places in Nizhny Novgorod, Mordovia and on to Anapa, and gives a capacity of up to 31.5 billion cubic meters a year for a part of the list. This differs from the 63 billion on the sheet, so a person should check which part of item 19 the 31.5 figure applies to. The decree gives no length, diameter or cost.

Interfax, 19 July 2019. Gazprom decided to finish the Pochinki to Anapa pipeline for the home market. Length 1625.6 km, more than 500 km already built, Southern Corridor first stage Pisarevka to Anapa 472 km.

Rossiyskaya Gazeta, 22 July 2022. Gas supplied in early July 2022 to the part from km 0 to km 295. Diameter 1420 mm, working pressure up to 9.8 MPa, capacity in future up to 63 billion cubic meters a year, total length 1622 km.

Contractor ZAO GSP page, read through the September 2020 archived copy. Gives capacity of up to 63.0 billion cubic meters a year for the Eastern corridor second stage, on the part from km 978 to km 1231.
Gazprom Transgaz Saratov newspaper, issue 15 of 7 April 2023, read through the April 2023 archived copy. Reports construction works on the Pochinki to Anapa pipeline in Petrovsk district.

Neftegaz, July 2019, read through the July 2024 archived copy. Gives 1625.6 km, more than 500 km built, and a 2014 tender of 16.6 billion rubles for two sections of 295.7 km. Gives no cost for the whole pipeline.
Moscow Times, 22 July 2019. Construction was shelved in 2015 and resumes. Gives 715 billion rubles at 2012 prices for the whole Southern Corridor, which is not a figure for this row.

Gazprom Proektirovanie news of 26 March 2021, read through the March 2023 archived copy. Positive state review of the design for km 963.7 to km 1168.1, 204.4 km, and capacity of up to 63 billion cubic meters a year.
Tender listing page, read through the June 2024 archived copy. The tender number named in the wiki is not on the archived page, and no Pochinki to Anapa entry could be found on it.

Gazprom tender list for May 2025 as a spreadsheet. Offers construction work on the Pochinki to Anapa sections km 661 to km 834 and km 1168.1 to km 1231, for gas supply of up to 63 billion cubic meters a year. Shows construction still going on in 2025.

2023 regional news: a 51 km section of Pochinki-Anapa is built and 145.5 km more is planned by the end of 2023 across Saratov Oblast. These are section figures, not the full 1625 km. It supports construction status and is already a Status ref.

summary: Capacity, diameter, length and status supported. Cost of 53.12 billion rubles and start year 2023 are not stated by any citation.
